title: Ordered relative symmetric-Proj comparison with affine polynomial twists
statement: Let $S$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme], $E$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_S$-module [pqf-def-coherent], $r\geq0$, and $b:\mathcal O_S^{r+1}\cong E$ an ordered isomorphism, with the free sheaf of [def-nagata-relative-projective-space]. Write $A(E)$ for the canonical symmetric graded algebra [def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra] and $P=\operatorname{Proj}_S A(E)$ [def-nagata-relative-proj]. There exists an isomorphism $e:P\cong\mathbf P^r_S$ to relative projective space, over $S$, such that AffineFreeComparison r b e V [def-per-projective-bundle-quotient-data] holds for every affine open $V$. Explicitly, for $R=\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_S)$ there is a bijective graded map $\beta:R[T_0,\ldots,T_r]\to\operatorname{Sym}_R(E(V))$ fixing coefficients and sending $T_i$ to $\iota(b(e_i))$. Its Proj map is the isomorphism $e_C$ from this symmetric Proj to polynomial Proj. Pulling back the polynomial degree-one twist along $e_C$ gives the symmetric degree-one twist [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf], with every homogeneous linear polynomial section sent to its beta image using the canonical unit comparison of pullbacks [def-pc-module-pullback]. The defining polynomial chart gamma of relative projective space induces an isomorphism $e_R$, and the equation $\iota_V e=e_C e_R^{-1}(\mathrm{restrictionIso}_V)^{-1}\iota_{\pi^{-1}V}$ holds. These statements include $r=0$, zero coefficient rings and empty affine charts.

proof.text: Transport the standard finite-function basis along the section isomorphism of b. Mathlib SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial gives beta, fixing coefficients and sending each variable to iota(b(e_i)). The degree-one submodule is the span of the variables; mapping its nth power identifies every polynomial homogeneous piece with the nth power of the symmetric-generator range. Naturality of b and the free inclusions proves restriction compatibility on variables, and polynomial extensionality proves it on all polynomials. The defining affinePolynomialEquiv gives gamma after ULift reindexing. Its coefficient and grading formulas are part of the relative-projective-space construction; its restriction formula is the last clause of the existing free-projective-bundle base-change comparison.

Compose beta with gamma inverse on every affine to construct inverse morphisms of graded algebra data. Relative-Proj functoriality gives eRel over S. Surjectivity gives the irrelevant-ideal witnesses, and the inverse graded ring maps give eC and eR by Proj.map_comp and Proj.map_id. The affine chart formula is relProjι_relProjMap followed by Proj.map_comp: beta composed with gamma inverse is exactly the affine component of the global algebra isomorphism. The realization restriction identity supplies the inclusion of the relative-projective-space chart, including its identity comparison between submodule and additive-subgroup gradings.

Apply the existing scalar-extension twist comparison with R=S=Gamma(V,O), the multiplication isomorphism R tensor_R P = P followed by beta, and the Proj map of beta. Degree preservation was proved in step 1; the standard-open and away-chart equations are the Proj.map formulas. Take the degree-one member of its twist family. Its homogeneous-section clause sends the pullback of s/1 to beta(s)/1. To obtain the full unitToTwist morphism equation, transpose both morphisms by the tensor-pullback adjunction. The left-adjoint uniqueness comparison sends the usual pullback-unit isomorphism to the structure-sheaf map. Morphisms from the unit sheaf are determined by their value at the global section 1, so the section clause gives equality. The argument imposes no nonzero-ring or nonempty-chart hypothesis and applies also to r=0. The proved explicit-witness constructor then assembles these fields into AffineFreeComparison without repeating its expensive definitional conversion.

theorem exists_ordered_relative_comparison (S : Scheme.{u}) (E : S.Modules)
    [E.IsQuasicoherent] (r : ℕ) (b : RelativeProjectiveSpace.freeModule S r ≅ E) :
    ∃ eRel : (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProj ≅
        RelativeProjectiveSpace.scheme S r,
      eRel.hom ≫ RelativeProjectiveSpace.π S r =
        (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom ∧
      ∀ V : S.affineOpens, ProjectiveBundleQuotientGeometry.AffineFreeComparison r b eRel V
